svg.style: max-width: 100%; height: auto; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Horizontal bar chart comparing rental yields. Shanghai city centre 1.77%, Shanghai outside centre 2.07%, required investor benchmark 3.5%.
svg.title: Gross Rental Yield — Shanghai vs. Required Benchmark
svg.desc: Shanghai city-centre gross rental yield is 1.77% and outside-centre is 2.07% (Numbeo, 2026). A value investor requires at least 3.5% yield to compensate for illiquidity and risk. Shanghai yields are roughly half the required threshold.
svg.text: Gross Rental Yield — Shanghai vs. Required Benchmark
